- Focus: Countries & Nationalities

Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

country — a land with its own government. Example: Italy is a country.
nationality — the country you belong to. Example: Her nationality is Italian.
city — a large town. Example: Rome is a big city.
capital — the main city of a country. Example: Paris is the capital of France.
from — the place where you start or were born. Example: I am from Spain.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Where are you from?
• I am from...
• I live in...
• What is your nationality?
• The capital of ... is ...

Grammar focus: Verb 'be' + nationality adjectives, prep 'from'.
Use be + from for origin: I am from Italy. Use be + nationality adjective: She is Italian. Ask Where are you from?
Controlled practice: choose the correct option.
Complete: She ___ from Brazil.

Reading: read the text and answer the questions.
Lucia is from Brazil. She is Brazilian. She lives in Sao Paulo. The capital of Brazil is Brasilia.
